workflow_metadata.workflow_name: Scientific Reflow - Setup for Knowledge Discovery
workflow_metadata.description: Initialize scientific discovery project for beamline/laboratory experiments with knowledge gap identification
workflow_metadata.purpose: Set up experimental system modeling project, configure paths, define scientific goals, and prepare for gap closure analysis

workflow_steps.description: Create project structure and configure paths for scientific discovery workflow

actions.details: Ask user for: (1) Scientific Reflow path (default: /path/to/reflow/scientific-reflow), (2) Experimental system path (where experimental_system_architecture.json will be created)
Create context/working_memory.json with paths, current workflow (00-scientific_setup), framework (experimental_scientific_systems)

workflow_steps.description: Define the experimental goal and identify the knowledge gap (System D)

actions.description: Ask user to describe the experiment
actions.details: Questions: (1) What facility/beamline are you using? (2) What are you trying to discover? (3) What sample/system is under investigation? (4) What measurements will be performed?
Ask: What properties of System D (sample) are UNKNOWN? What do you want to infer? Examples: crystal structure, chemical composition, electronic states, phase transitions
What would constitute successful gap closure? Examples: determine crystal space group, identify chemical species, measure band gap

workflow_steps.description: Plan how to categorize experimental components into Systems A, B, C, D, E

actions.details: Explain the 5-system model: A (Source), B (Manipulation), C (Environment), D (Sample - UNKNOWN), E (Detection). Show beamline example from framework definition.

actions.description: Ask user to list experimental components
actions.details: Ask: What are all the physical components in your experiment? (sources, optics, sample stages, detectors, environmental controls, etc.)
LLM suggests categorization into Systems A, B, C, D, E based on user's component list. User reviews and approves.

criteria: System categorization plan approved by user

workflow_steps.description: Configure Scientific Reflow tools for gap closure analysis

actions.details: Check that required tools exist: system_of_systems_graph_v2.py, reflow_gap_closure.py, matrix_gap_detection.py, link_architectures.py
Check networkx >= 3.0, numpy, scipy (for SVD). If missing, prompt user to install: pip install networkx numpy scipy OR pixi install

actions.description: Store tool paths in working memory
actions.details: Update context/working_memory.json with tool paths: tools_path, scientific_reflow_root, reflow_root

workflow_steps.description: Finalize setup and prepare for experimental modeling

actions.description: Update working memory for next workflow

actions.details: Create docs/setup_summary.md with: project paths, scientific goal, knowledge gaps, system categorization plan, tool configuration
Ask: 'Setup complete! Ready to model your experimental system? Proceed to workflow 01-experimental_modeling.'

criteria: Working memory updated for next workflow

context_refresh_triggers.description: Refresh context every 10 operations to prevent drift
